On 2026-10-02, The Guardian reported “Now, Doe is suing the seven men whom she said perpetrated the assault, and also the university itself, the fraternity and others.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “The lawsuit seeks to hold all seven men liable for rape. She is asking for unspecified damages.”.

On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “The woman, identified in court papers only as Jane Doe, sued Cornell and seven former students last month, alleging she was given ketamine and repeatedly assaulted at a fraternity house in October 2024.”; on the same day, CBS News reported “CBS News has reached out to the seven defendants named in the lawsuit for comment. Attorneys for two of them have denied the allegations.”.
